svg.title: PilarPrep AWS Architecture
svg.desc: PilarPrep architecture using official AWS service icons. Route 53 resolves the domain; website requests reach CloudFront directly. The React app runs in the user browser. CloudFront serves private frontend S3 and proxies application requests to API Gateway. Cognito, ACM, and WAF support access and HTTPS. Jobs API Lambda writes job state and queues work through SQS to the AI Worker. Brief generation and refinement use Bedrock. Handoff, catch-up, and meeting transcript analysis use AgentCore with Strands and scoped approved evidence from Bedrock Knowledge Bases backed by S3 Vectors. Validate and save is a step inside the AI Worker, not a separate Lambda. Audio uploads require sign-in; GuardDuty malware-scan events return through EventBridge to the same queue. The worker starts Transcribe only after a clean scan. A second EventBridge completion event returns to the same queue, and the worker reads the transcript before AgentCore analysis. Unredacted customer context is preserved. AgentCore tools and memory are intentionally collapsed. This is a service-flow view, not a VPC or subnet diagram.

g.text: Transcript ready to the same queue
